name: Daily Code Words
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Code Words is a word game where you must decipher the letter behind each number. If you are a fan of crosswords but want to really challenge yourself, then you need to check out this difficult game. Test your knowledge of words without hints as you try to figure out the letters for each number.  Each daily game will give you the answer to 2 numbers. It is up to you to find the rest of the letters. This is not a bunch of random letters as they will spell out either words or names. You have two modes to play in depending on how much of a challenge you want: 13X13 and 15X15.
